segments.text: You have a choice to resist... Whether it will work or not is another matter.
"Sin is one way to build new relationships..." Who was it that said that?

After graduating from a university in Tokyo, he has become a civil servant. He is an employee of the Aramatsuri Countermeasures Division (professional job in the Tokyo Metropolitan Government). He is originally from Nagano City, Nagano Prefecture.

The Aramatsuri Countermeasures Division is comprised of individuals who can sense, control, and eliminate Aramatsuri. Recruitment is done by staff members at the Tokyo Metropolitan Government who are sensitive to Aramatsuri, and can identify and scout individuals. The protagonist was also scouted during his third year of university and accepted without taking an exam.
Nothing happened when he was in the countryside, but his powers awakened because Tokyo is overflowing with Aramatsuri.
The existence of the department is not disclosed to the general public, so his business card reads "Member of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's Bureau for the Promotion of Public Safety."
Kurotori's abilities are:
• "The ability to sense Aramatsuri".
• "The ability to find people influenced by Aramatsuri".
• "The ability to find souls corrupted by Aramatsuri".
• "The ability to shape Aramatsuri freely to a certain extent".
Kurotori primarily uses Aramatsuri as a sword, but his weapons may vary depending on the battle situation.
His personality is reserved, and some describe him as "unassuming" or "lacking personality."
Translated from Official website
It's not a problem. Fighting is my specialty.
Born and raised in Tokyo.
Kurotori's senior in the Aramatsuri Countermeasures Division.

He is the heir to the Tendō Kekka-shiki Ittō-ryū school, whose home and dojo are located in Yotsuya 3-chome (Yotsuya-sanchome, a neighborhood and major intersection in Shinjuku Ward, Tokyo, centered around Yotsuya-sanchome Station on the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line). His power is of the Amaterasu lineage, capable of annihilating the power of Aramatsuri.
The Tendō Kekka-shiki Ittō-ryū has long possessed the power of Amaterasu, and it is almost customary for its swordsmen to join the Countermeasures Division.
Although originally from a family of Onmyōdō practitioners, their ties to Onmyōdō have weakened considerably, and they maintain a distance from the Tsuchimikado faction, which aims to revive Onmyōdō.
He is an extremely strong swordsman, and he still trains at his home dojo about twice a week.
He has an earnest and reliable personality.
He lives at home with his parents and younger brother. His older brother disappeared several years ago.
Translated from Official website
Let forth the sacred pillar Onbashira, where the Totem of the Great Snake resides, oh Chibiki Stone of the Underworld!
Born in Okinawa.
He primarily uses the principles of original Shinto, employing the Onbashira ritual (the act of erecting giant trees on the ground to gain power) to unleash the fierce power of the gods.
The source of his power is the supreme sun goddess Amaterasu.

Although he is an employee of the Aramatsuri Countermeasures Division, he is on a contract basis and belongs to a different organization. However, he has the longest tenure in the department and possesses deep knowledge about many subjects.
Due to the complexity of his background, few truly understand him.
He has a friendly relationship with his superior, Mikiko, and can talk to her easily.
Translated from Official website
Hey, there is a person here who might die! Think about helping them first!
Born in Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture.

An entertainer. Belongs to Star Junior Pro in Nakameguro. Skilled and hardworking. Although he appeared in street style photos as early as high school, he only began seriously pursuing a career in entertainment at the age of 20. His high physical abilities have led him to work as a stuntman for idols and actors. He strives to be superior to other entertainers his age, diligently mastering parkour and stage combat. Recently, he has been appearing more frequently in dramas and commercials, albeit in minor roles.
He comes from a unique family background, which brings both good and bad fortune.
Translated from Official website
Disguising yourself as something temporary... It's exactly like the entertainment industry. That's what Onmyōdō is all about. ...Right, Kurotori-san?
Born in Kochi Prefecture.
A bartender and owner of a bar in Shinjuku 3-chome.

His family lineage is connected to Onmyōdō (lit., "Way of Yin and Yang" — occult divination system based on the Taoist theory of the five elements​), but Onmyōdō itself is in decline. Disillusioned with this, he moved to Tokyo and entered the nightlife industry, which has many Onmyōdō practitioners.

However, a faction of Onmyōdō practitioners has begun lobbying to gradually revive Onmyōdō's influence. Currently, a member of the Tsuchimikado school is a Tokyo Metropolitan Assembly member and is pushing for the establishment of an Onmyōryō (Bureau of Onmyōdō) within Tokyo. Even so, many people who have already established themselves in Kabukicho do not want to be involved with Onmyōdō again, and Isshiki is one of them.
He gives an impression that he can only use charms a little.
He has connections in businesses that primarily operate at night, as well as in industries dealing with death, such as the police, crematoriums, and funeral homes.
He loves dogs.
Translated from Official website
In that sense, when an unexpected situation arises, Kurotori will be the first to act. Do you understand? He can even produce a sword from his hands.
She is the head of the Aramatsuri Countermeasures Division. She has been the division's leader for a long time and holds considerable authority.
She has a friendly personality and a particularly long-standing relationship with Inami.
She is a good superior who especially respects Kurotori's decisions.
Translated from Official website
